Aerodrom je u evropskom dijelu grada i mnogi putnici tu presjedaju.
The airport is in the European part of the city, and many passengers change planes there.
Dacešin je rekao da tu presjeda desetak puta godišnje i da je svaki put sve skuplje.
Dacešin said that he changes planes there about ten times a year and that it gets more expensive every time.
Napisao je da ne zna postoji li na svijetu trenutno skuplje mjesto.
He wrote that he does not know whether there is a more expensive place in the world right now.
Mnogi pratioci složili su se s njim, a neki su napisali da hranu uvijek nose od kuće.
Many followers agreed with him, and some wrote that they always bring food from home.

title: Schmidt: Pitanje secesije RS-a još nije završeno
Schmidt: The question of RS secession is not over yet
body: Bivši visoki predstavnik Christian Schmidt govorio je u Berlinu o stanju u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Former High Representative Christian Schmidt spoke in Berlin about the situation in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Diskusija je održana u Evropskoj kući, blizu Brandenburške kapije, a tema je bio Dejtonski sporazum.
The discussion was held in the European House, near the Brandenburg Gate, and the topic was the Dayton Agreement.
Schmidt je ovog ljeta napustio funkciju nakon pritiska iz SAD-a.
Schmidt left the post this summer after pressure from the USA.
Rekao je da pitanje secesije Republike Srpske nije potpuno skinuto s dnevnog reda.
He said that the question of the secession of Republika Srpska has not been completely removed from the agenda.
Prema njegovim riječima, postojao je ozbiljan rizik da se referendum o nezavisnosti RS-a održi već 2027. godine.
According to him, there was a serious risk that a referendum on the independence of RS would be held as early as 2027.
Ipak, on ne vjeruje da bi stanovnici RS-a podržali takav referendum.
However, he does not believe that the residents of RS would support such a referendum.
Schmidt misli da je secesija manje vjerovatna nakon promjena u Srbiji.
Schmidt thinks that secession is less likely after the changes in Serbia.
Dodao je da je BiH još daleko od članstva u Evropskoj uniji.
He added that BiH is still far from membership in the European Union.
Niels von Redecker iz njemačkog ministarstva vanjskih poslova rekao je da BiH nije ni u drugoj, nego tek u trećoj grupi kandidata.
Niels von Redecker from the German foreign ministry said that BiH is not even in the second, but only in the third group of candidates.
Ambasador BiH u Njemačkoj Damir Arnaut rekao je da mnogi političari ne žele EU, jer bi tada mogli završiti pod istragom.
The BiH ambassador to Germany, Damir Arnaut, said that many politicians do not want the EU, because then they could end up under investigation.

title: Novi krvni test mogao bi rano otkriti rak jajnika
New blood test could detect ovarian cancer early
body: Američki naučnici razvili su krvni test koji bi mogao otkriti rane promjene prije raka jajnika.
American scientists have developed a blood test that could detect early changes before ovarian cancer.
Istraživanje je vodio institut Hoag u Kaliforniji, a rezultati su objavljeni u časopisu Nature Medicine.
The research was led by the Hoag institute in California, and the results were published in the journal Nature Medicine.
Test još nije odobren i pacijentima zasad nije dostupan.
The test has not yet been approved and is not available to patients for now.
Test mjeri u krvi jednu molekulu koja je povišena kod žena s ranim promjenama u jajovodu.
The test measures one molecule in the blood which is raised in women with early changes in the fallopian tube.
Te promjene ne vide se na snimanju ni na običnim krvnim nalazima.
These changes cannot be seen on scans or in ordinary blood results.
Test je otkrio promjene kod 92,3 posto žena koje su ih imale.
The test detected the changes in 92.3 percent of women who had them.
Kod zdravih žena tačan rezultat dao je u 98,2 posto slučajeva.
In healthy women, it gave a correct result in 98.2 percent of cases.
Doktor Rajan Gogna rekao je da rak jajnika ne počinje onog dana kada se otkrije tumor.
Doctor Rajan Gogna said that ovarian cancer does not begin on the day when a tumour is found.
Glavna istraživačica Esha Madan vjeruje da bi test mogao pomoći ženama s visokim rizikom.
The lead researcher, Esha Madan, believes that the test could help women at high risk.
Naučnici sada planiraju nova istraživanja, jer su do sada analizirali samo starije uzorke krvi.
The scientists are now planning new studies, because so far they have only analysed older blood samples.

title: BH Fanaticosi pozivaju navijače da u Solnu dođu u crnom
BH Fanaticos call on fans to come to Solna in black
body: Navijačka grupa BH Fanaticos pozvala je navijače BiH na zajednički marš do stadiona u Solni.
The fan group BH Fanaticos has called BiH fans to a joint march to the stadium in Solna.
Reprezentacija BiH u subotu igra protiv Švedske u Ligi nacija.
The BiH national team plays against Sweden in the Nations League on Saturday.
Navijači trebaju doći obučeni u crno, jer će i grupa nositi crnu odjeću.
Fans should come dressed in black, because the group will also wear black clothes.
Poziv je objavljen na Facebook stranici "Operacija Stockholm".
The call was published on the Facebook page "Operacija Stockholm".
Mjesto i vrijeme okupljanja biće objavljeni na dan utakmice.
The meeting place and time will be announced on the day of the match.
Svih 52.000 ulaznica je prodano, a sektor za gostujuće navijače je pun.
All 52,000 tickets have been sold, and the section for away fans is full.
Utakmica počinje u 20:45, a pobjeda bi Zmajeve dovela na prvo mjesto u grupi.
The match starts at 20:45, and a win would take the Dragons to first place in the group.
Grupa podsjeća da u Švedskoj živi mnogo ljudi porijeklom iz BiH, a hiljade će doći i iz drugih zemalja.
The group reminds that many people of BiH origin live in Sweden, and thousands will also come from other countries.
Od navijača traže da budu glasni, ali i dostojanstveni.
They ask fans to be loud, but also dignified.
Sličan marš organizovali su u oktobru u Zenici, kada su BiH i Švedska igrale 1:1.
They organised a similar march in October in Zenica, when BiH and Sweden played 1:1.
Švedski selektor Graham Potter rekao je da očekuje mnogo navijača BiH na tribinama.
Swedish head coach Graham Potter said that he expects many BiH fans in the stands.

title: Katić: Muharemović je među pet najboljih stopera svijeta
Katić: Muharemović is among the five best centre-backs in the world
body: Štoper reprezentacije BiH Nikola Katić rekao je da je subotnja utakmica protiv Švedske najvažnija u ovom dijelu Lige nacija.
BiH national team centre-back Nikola Katić said that Saturday's match against Sweden is the most important in this part of the Nations League.
Zmajevi igraju u Solni kod Stockholma, a tri dana kasnije dočekuju Rumuniju u Zenici.
The Dragons play in Solna near Stockholm, and three days later they host Romania in Zenica.
Jedna pobjeda donosi drugo mjesto, a dvije pobjede prvo mjesto u grupi.
One win brings second place, and two wins first place in the group.
Katić kaže da Švedska ima brze igrače s mnogo kvaliteta.
Katić says that Sweden has fast players with a lot of quality.
Ipak, smatra da i BiH ima talentovane igrače i da će igrati bez straha.
Still, he thinks that BiH also has talented players and that they will play without fear.
Na utakmici neće igrati Tarik Muharemović, jer ima previše žutih kartona.
Tarik Muharemović will not play in the match, because he has too many yellow cards.
Katić je rekao da je to veliki gubitak i da je Muharemović možda među pet najboljih štopera na svijetu.
Katić said that this is a big loss and that Muharemović may be among the five best centre-backs in the world.
Dodao je da će ostali odbrambeni igrači dobro odraditi posao.
He added that the other defenders will do the job well.
Edin Džeko, koji se u oktobru oprostio od reprezentacije, doći će na utakmicu da podrži tim.
Edin Džeko, who said goodbye to the national team in October, will come to the match to support the team.
Katić je rekao da se on i Džeko stalno čuju i da će ga biti teško zamijeniti.
Katić said that he and Džeko talk all the time and that he will be hard to replace.
Katić ima ugovor sa Schalkeom do ljeta 2028. godine.
Katić has a contract with Schalke until the summer of 2028.

title: Preminuo Steve Connors, fotoreporter iz opkoljenog Sarajeva
Steve Connors, photojournalist from besieged Sarajevo, has died
body: Preminuo je britanski fotoreporter i dokumentarista Steve Connors, koji je snimao opkoljeno Sarajevo tokom rata.
British photojournalist and documentary maker Steve Connors, who photographed besieged Sarajevo during the war, has died.
Vijest je objavio Sniper Alley, arhiv fotografija i svjedočenja fotografa iz vremena opsade.
The news was announced by Sniper Alley, an archive of photographs and testimonies of photographers from the time of the siege.
Na Instagramu su ga nazvali dragim prijateljem i izuzetnim čovjekom.
On Instagram they called him a dear friend and an exceptional man.
Napisali su i da ga Bosanci nikada neće zaboraviti.
They also wrote that Bosnians will never forget him.
Connors je rođen u Sheffieldu, na sjeveru Engleske.
Connors was born in Sheffield, in the north of England.
Bio je vojni policajac u britanskoj vojsci, gdje je sam naučio fotografisati.
He was a military policeman in the British army, where he taught himself to take photographs.
Kasnije je izvještavao iz bivše Jugoslavije, Afganistana, Iraka, Čečenije, Ukrajine i drugih zemalja.
Later he reported from the former Yugoslavia, Afghanistan, Iraq, Chechnya, Ukraine and other countries.
Njegove fotografije objavljivali su Time, Newsweek, Der Spiegel i The Guardian.
His photographs were published by Time, Newsweek, Der Spiegel and The Guardian.
Pomogao je osnovati neprofitnu novinsku organizaciju Orb Media.
He helped found the non-profit news organisation Orb Media.
Godine 2007. s novinarkom Molly Bingham snimio je dokumentarni film "Meeting Resistance" o ratu u Iraku.
In 2007, with journalist Molly Bingham, he made the documentary film "Meeting Resistance" about the war in Iraq.
Za taj film proveli su deset mjeseci s pobunjenicima u Bagdadu.
For that film they spent ten months with insurgents in Baghdad.

title: Simulacija: BiH bi mogla igrati s Engleskom i Španijom
Simulation: BiH could play England and Spain
body: Portal Football Meets Data objavio je simulaciju žrijeba za kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo 2030. godine.
The portal Football Meets Data published a simulation of the draw for the 2030 World Cup qualifiers.
Po toj simulaciji, BiH bi bila u grupi od 12 reprezentacija, među kojima su Engleska, Španija, Italija i Hrvatska.
According to that simulation, BiH would be in a group of 12 national teams, including England, Spain, Italy and Croatia.
To nije zvanični žrijeb, nego samo primjer kako bi grupa mogla izgledati.
It is not an official draw, but only an example of how the group could look.
To će biti prve kvalifikacije po novom formatu UEFA-e, koji je predstavljen u maju.
These will be the first qualifiers under UEFA's new format, which was presented in May.
Svih 54 evropske reprezentacije biće podijeljene u dvije lige, prema rezultatima u Ligi nacija.
All 54 European national teams will be divided into two leagues, according to their results in the Nations League.
U prvoj ligi su 36 timova u tri grupe od po 12, a svaki tim igra šest utakmica.
The first league has 36 teams in three groups of 12, and each team plays six matches.
Pobjednici tih grupa direktno idu na Svjetsko prvenstvo.
The winners of those groups go directly to the World Cup.
Timovi iz druge lige mogu se plasirati samo kroz baraž.
Teams from the second league can qualify only through the playoffs.
Bit će manje utakmica, ali mnogo više susreta jakih reprezentacija.
There will be fewer matches, but many more meetings of strong national teams.
BiH više ne bi igrala protiv San Marina, Andore ili Gibraltara.
BiH would no longer play against San Marino, Andorra or Gibraltar.
Predsjednik UEFA-e Aleksander Čeferin rekao je da će novi format smanjiti broj utakmica u kojima se ništa ne odlučuje.
UEFA President Aleksander Čeferin said that the new format would reduce the number of matches in which nothing is decided.

title: WhatsApp testira poruke koje nestaju nakon čitanja
WhatsApp tests messages that disappear after reading
body: WhatsApp testira opciju "View Once" i za tekstualne poruke.
WhatsApp is testing the "View Once" option for text messages too.
Takva poruka može se pročitati samo jednom, a nakon toga nestaje.
Such a message can be read only once, and after that it disappears.
Prema portalu WABetaInfo, opcija je sada dostupna nekim korisnicima beta verzije za Android.
According to the portal WABetaInfo, the option is now available to some users of the beta version for Android.
Ova opcija već postoji za fotografije, video snimke i glasovne poruke.
This option already exists for photos, videos and voice messages.
Da bi poslao takvu poruku, korisnik treba duže držati dugme za slanje i izabrati "View Once".
To send such a message, the user needs to hold the send button longer and choose "View Once".
Primalac poruku otvara u posebnom prozoru, a kada ga zatvori, ne može je ponovo otvoriti.
The recipient opens the message in a separate window, and when they close it, they cannot open it again.
Poruka se ne može kopirati ni proslijediti, a aplikacija blokira snimke ekrana.
The message cannot be copied or forwarded, and the app blocks screenshots.
Ipak, sadržaj se i dalje može fotografisati kamerom drugog telefona.
However, the content can still be photographed with the camera of another phone.
Ni WhatsApp ni pošiljalac to ne mogu spriječiti.
Neither WhatsApp nor the sender can prevent that.
Zasad nije poznato kada će nova opcija biti dostupna svim korisnicima.
For now it is not known when the new option will be available to all users.

title: Poništen tender od 34 miliona KM za zidove protiv buke
A 34-million-KM tender for noise walls is cancelled
body: Tender za gradnju zidova protiv buke na autoputu A1 između Drivuše i Visokog je poništen.
The tender for building noise walls on the A1 motorway between Drivuša and Visoko has been cancelled.
Odluku je donio Ured za razmatranje žalbi, nakon što je neko podnio žalbu.
The decision was made by the Appeals Review Office, after someone filed a complaint.
Tender je raspisala firma JP Autoceste FBiH krajem juna.
The tender was announced by the company JP Autoceste FBiH at the end of June.
Posao je bio vrijedan 29 miliona KM bez PDV-a, odnosno skoro 34 miliona KM s PDV-om.
The job was worth 29 million KM without VAT, or almost 34 million KM with VAT.
Ugovor bi trajao tri godine, a pobijedila bi firma s najnižom cijenom.
The contract would last three years, and the company with the lowest price would win.
Nije poznato ko je podnio žalbu i da li će biti raspisan novi tender.
It is not known who filed the complaint or whether a new tender will be announced.
Istog dana raspisan je i tender za nadzor radova, vrijedan 702.000 KM s PDV-om.
On the same day a tender for supervising the works, worth 702,000 KM with VAT, was also announced.
Dionica Drivuša–Visoko otvorena je 2005. godine bez zidova protiv buke.
The Drivuša–Visoko section opened in 2005 without noise walls.
Firma kaže da tada zakon nije tražio da se misli na buku.
The company says that the law at that time did not require thinking about noise.
Zidovi bi pomogli stanovnicima naselja kao što su Arnautovići, Kalotići i Čifluk.
The walls would help residents of settlements such as Arnautovići, Kalotići and Čifluk.
Autoceste FBiH su ove godine poništile 37 od 199 svojih nabavki.
Autoceste FBiH has cancelled 37 of its 199 procurements this year.

title: Goran Milić: Hrvati u Čileu i BiH žive bolje od većine
Goran Milić: Croats in Chile and BiH live better than the majority
body: Hrvatski novinar Goran Milić rekao je da postoje samo dvije zemlje u kojima Hrvati kao manjina žive bolje od većine.
Croatian journalist Goran Milić said there are only two countries where Croats as a minority live better than the majority.
To su, kako je rekao, Čile i Bosna i Hercegovina.
These are, as he said, Chile and Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Milić je bio gost podcasta Kliker, gdje je govorio o Hrvatima u Južnoj Americi.
Milić was a guest on the Kliker podcast, where he talked about Croats in South America.
Rekao je da su Hrvati u Čileu u prosjeku bogatiji od Čileanaca španskog i italijanskog porijekla.
He said that Croats in Chile are on average richer than Chileans of Spanish and Italian origin.
Kao primjer je naveo da su Hrvati bili predsjednici Čilea, a neki su danas senatori.
As an example he mentioned that Croats have been presidents of Chile, and some are senators today.
Trener Mirko Jozić donio je Čileu najveći nogometni uspjeh, a aerodrom je projektovao hrvatski arhitekt.
Coach Mirko Jozić brought Chile its greatest football success, and the airport was designed by a Croatian architect.
U Argentini su Hrvati također uspješni, ali ne kao u Čileu.
In Argentina Croats are also successful, but not like in Chile.
Prema Miliću, Hrvati u Njemačkoj i Americi bogatiji su od Hrvata u Hrvatskoj.
According to Milić, Croats in Germany and America are richer than Croats in Croatia.
Ipak, nisu bogatiji od Nijemaca ili Amerikanaca.
However, they are not richer than Germans or Americans.
Za BiH je rekao da je to jedina druga zemlja gdje najmanji narod ima bolji položaj od najvećeg.
About BiH he said that it is the only other country where the smallest people has a better position than the largest.
Njegove riječi izazvale su mnogo komentara na portalu.
His words caused many comments on the portal.

title: Stranke se bore za tri ministarstva u Vijeću ministara
Parties fight over three ministries in the Council of Ministers
body: Stranke koje žele formirati novu vlast na nivou BiH još nisu sjele za zajednički sto.
The parties that want to form the new state-level government have not yet sat down at a common table.
Do sada su održani samo odvojeni sastanci, između HDZ-a i SNSD-a, te Dragana Čovića s liderima SDA i SDP-a.
So far there have only been separate meetings, between HDZ and SNSD, and between Dragan Čović and the leaders of SDA and SDP.
Konkretnog dogovora o podjeli ministarstava zasad nema.
There is no concrete agreement on dividing the ministries for now.
Prema nezvaničnim informacijama, SNSD i partneri traže četiri ministarstva, ali bi prihvatili i tri.
According to unofficial information, SNSD and its partners are asking for four ministries, but would also accept three.
HDZ želi tri, a SDA i njeni partneri bi dobili dva ili tri ministarstva i mjesto predsjedavajućeg.
HDZ wants three, while SDA and its partners would get two or three ministries and the post of chairman.
Najveća borba očekuje se oko ministarstava vanjskih poslova, finansija i vanjske trgovine.
The biggest fight is expected over the ministries of foreign affairs, finance and foreign trade.
Vanjske poslove žele i SDA i HDZ, dok SNSD želi zadržati finansije.
Both SDA and HDZ want foreign affairs, while SNSD wants to keep finance.
Za vanjsku trgovinu, koju sada vodi Staša Košarac iz SNSD-a, zanima se i SDA.
SDA is also interested in foreign trade, which is now run by Staša Košarac of SNSD.
Ministarstvo odbrane bi, kako se očekuje, trebalo pripasti SDA.
The Ministry of Defence is expected to go to SDA.
Prema nepisanom pravilu, predsjedavajući bi sada trebao doći iz probosanskog bloka.
According to an unwritten rule, the chairman should now come from the pro-Bosnian bloc.
Prethodni predsjedavajući bili su Zoran Tegeltija iz SNSD-a i Borjana Krišto iz HDZ-a.
The previous chairs were Zoran Tegeltija of SNSD and Borjana Krišto of HDZ.
Konačan dogovor zavisi od toga koliko su stranke spremne na kompromis.
The final agreement depends on how ready the parties are to compromise.

title: Kako mozak nauči voljeti kafu i drugu hranu
How the brain learns to love coffee and other food
body: Naučnici s Univerziteta Kalifornije u San Franciscu otkrili su kako mozak polako uči voljeti određenu hranu.
Scientists from the University of California, San Francisco have discovered how the brain slowly learns to love certain food.
Istraživanje je 4. novembra objavljeno u časopisu Nature.
The research was published on 4 November in the journal Nature.
Važnu ulogu ima dopamin, hemijska tvar u mozgu koja je povezana s nagradom i učenjem.
An important role is played by dopamine, a chemical in the brain that is linked to reward and learning.
Kada hrana dođe u crijeva, ona šalju mozgu informaciju o šećeru i masti.
When food reaches the gut, it sends the brain information about sugar and fat.
Tada se dopamin oslobađa polako, nekoliko minuta, a mi to ne primjećujemo.
Then dopamine is released slowly, for several minutes, and we do not notice it.
Profesor Zachary Knight objasnio je da kafa postaje ugodna kada mozak poveže njen okus s djelovanjem kofeina.
Professor Zachary Knight explained that coffee becomes pleasant when the brain links its taste with the effect of caffeine.
U eksperimentima su miševi prestali učiti koji okus donosi kalorije kada su naučnici prekinuli taj put.
In experiments, mice stopped learning which taste brings calories when the scientists interrupted that pathway.
Slični rezultati dobijeni su i kod ljudi, a reakcija je bila jača u lijevoj strani mozga.
Similar results were also found in people, and the reaction was stronger in the left side of the brain.
Naučnici kažu da bi se jednog dana moglo mijenjati koliko volimo određenu hranu.
Scientists say that one day it might be possible to change how much we like certain food.
Knight smatra da lijekovi GLP-1, koji smanjuju apetit, možda slabe ovaj signal.
Knight thinks that GLP-1 drugs, which reduce appetite, may weaken this signal.
Ipak, to istraživanje nije provjeravalo, pa je to zasad samo pretpostavka.
However, the research did not test that, so for now it is only an assumption.

title: Garza prvi put u petorci, Boston slavio u Torontu
Garza in the starting five for the first time, Boston wins in Toronto
body: Bosanskohercegovački centar Luka Garza prvi put je ove sezone počeo utakmicu u prvoj petorci Boston Celticsa.
Bosnian-Herzegovinian centre Luka Garza started a game in the Boston Celtics' starting five for the first time this season.
Boston je u Torontu nadoknadio minus od 22 poena i pobijedio Raptorse rezultatom 98:93.
In Toronto Boston made up a 22-point deficit and beat the Raptors 98:93.
Trener Joe Mazzulla igrao je s dva centra, Garzom i Neemiasom Quetom, jer je Paul George bio bolestan.
Coach Joe Mazzulla played with two centres, Garza and Neemias Queta, because Paul George was ill.
Garza je za 11 minuta postigao 5 poena i imao jedan skok.
Garza scored 5 points in 11 minutes and had one rebound.
Prije ove utakmice prosječno je postizao 6,5 poena, a imao je i najbolji šut za tri poena u timu.
Before this game he averaged 6.5 points, and he also had the best three-point shooting on the team.
Jayson Tatum je 25 sekundi prije kraja pogodio dva slobodna bacanja i donio Bostonu vodstvo.
Jayson Tatum made two free throws 25 seconds before the end and gave Boston the lead.
Tatum je završio s 24 poena, a Boston sada ima pet pobjeda zaredom i omjer 10-2.
Tatum finished with 24 points, and Boston now has five wins in a row and a 10-2 record.
Garza je rekao da mu igra s dva centra daje još jednu priliku da dobije minute.
Garza said that playing with two centres gives him one more chance to get minutes.
Dodao je da želi potpuno prihvatiti tu ulogu.
He added that he wants to fully accept that role.
Iste noći San Antonio je pobijedio Chicago, a Victor Wembanyama postigao je 32 poena.
The same night San Antonio beat Chicago, and Victor Wembanyama scored 32 points.
Stephen Curry povrijedio se u prvoj četvrtini i nije se vratio u igru.
Stephen Curry got injured in the first quarter and did not return to the game.

title: Scarlett Johansson otvoreno o lošim ponudama iz Hollywooda
Scarlett Johansson speaks openly about bad offers from Hollywood
body: Glumica Scarlett Johansson rekla je da joj veliki holivudski studiji ponekad nude čudne projekte.
Actress Scarlett Johansson said that big Hollywood studios sometimes offer her strange projects.
Kod nekih filmova pita se zašto ih uopće snimaju.
With some films she wonders why they are being made at all.
To je rekla u intervjuu za Los Angeles Times, dok je promovisala nezavisnu dramu „Paper Tiger“.
She said this in an interview with the Los Angeles Times, while she was promoting the independent drama "Paper Tiger".
Producentima je rekla da bi snimanje takvih filmova bilo neodgovorno.
She told producers that making such films would be irresponsible.
Kada bira ulogu, pita se da li pravi nešto što drugi ljudi žele gledati.
When she chooses a role, she asks herself whether she is making something other people want to watch.
Nije rekla koji su je studiji razočarali.
She did not say which studios had disappointed her.
Film „Paper Tiger“ kupila je kompanija Neon prije premijere na festivalu u Cannesu.
The film "Paper Tiger" was bought by the company Neon before its premiere at the festival in Cannes.
Johansson je poznata po ulozi Crne udovice u Marvelovim filmovima.
Johansson is known for the role of Black Widow in the Marvel films.
Uskoro će glumiti u novom filmu reditelja Arija Astera „Scapegoat“, s Judeom Lawom.
She will soon act in director Ari Aster's new film "Scapegoat", with Jude Law.
Kaže da je scenarij vrlo intenzivan i da je dok ga je čitala stalno govorila „O, Bože!“.
She says that the script is very intense and that while she was reading it she kept saying "Oh, God!".

title: Duratović: SNSD bi mogao dobiti petog delegata u Domu naroda
Duratović: SNSD could get a fifth delegate in the House of Peoples
body: Mirsad Duratović, poslanik SDP-a u Narodnoj skupštini RS-a, upozorio je da u opoziciji ima „spavača“.
Mirsad Duratović, an SDP deputy in the RS National Assembly, warned that there are "sleepers" in the opposition.
Tako on naziva ljude koji tajno rade protiv jedinstva opozicije.
That is what he calls people who secretly work against the unity of the opposition.
Zbog njih bi SNSD i partneri mogli dobiti petog delegata u Domu naroda Parlamentarne skupštine BiH.
Because of them, SNSD and its partners could get a fifth delegate in the House of Peoples of the Parliamentary Assembly of BiH.
Duratović je to rekao u utorak uveče u emisiji „Plenum“ na Federalnoj televiziji.
Duratović said this on Tuesday evening on the programme "Plenum" on Federal Television.
Prije četiri godine SNSD je dobio četvrtog delegata, a krivica je prebačena na bošnjačke poslanike.
Four years ago SNSD got a fourth delegate, and the blame was shifted to the Bosniak deputies.
Duratović kaže da su oni tada glasali za svog kandidata, a da su krivi bili „preletači“ i svađa između SDS-a i PDP-a.
Duratović says they voted for their own candidate at the time, and that "defectors" and the quarrel between SDS and PDP were to blame.
Prema nekim informacijama, vladajuća koalicija sada bi mogla imati 57 ili 58 poslanika u skupštini.
According to some reports, the ruling coalition could now have 57 or 58 deputies in the assembly.
Neki poslanici čija se imena spominju rekli su da ne prelaze na drugu stranu.
Some deputies whose names are mentioned have said that they are not switching sides.
Duratović je rekao da je petak „pazarni dan“ u Banjoj Luci, kada se mogu praviti dogovori.
Duratović said that Friday is "market day" in Banja Luka, when deals can be made.
Dodao je da će stvari biti jasnije nakon ponedjeljka.
He added that things will be clearer after Monday.
SDP neće podržati kandidate SDS-a ni SNSD-a, ali konačnu odluku još nije donio.
SDP will not support SDS or SNSD candidates, but it has not yet made a final decision.
Stranka bi mogla imati svog kandidata ili ne bi glasala.
The party could have its own candidate or not vote.

title: Narandžasto upozorenje zbog jakog vjetra u BiH
Orange warning for strong wind in BiH
body: U BiH je danas upaljen narandžasti meteoalarm zbog jakog i olujnog vjetra.
An orange weather alert for strong and stormy wind has been issued in BiH today.
Upozorenje počinje u 12 sati i traje do petka, 13. novembra, u 9 sati.
The warning starts at 12 o'clock and lasts until Friday, 13 November, at 9 o'clock.
Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod očekuje udare vjetra od 60 do 80 kilometara na sat, a lokalno i do 90.
The Federal Hydrometeorological Institute expects wind gusts of 60 to 80 kilometres per hour, and locally up to 90.
Danas će biti pretežno oblačno, uz slabu kišu i lokalne pljuskove.
Today will be mostly cloudy, with light rain and local showers.
Jutarnja temperatura bit će od 11 do 17, a dnevna od 16 do 22 stepena.
The morning temperature will be from 11 to 17, and the daytime temperature from 16 to 22 degrees.
U Sarajevu se ujutro očekuje oko 12, a tokom dana oko 18 stepeni.
In Sarajevo about 12 degrees is expected in the morning, and about 18 during the day.
Za petak je izdato i upozorenje za obilnu kišu u Hercegovini i jugozapadnoj Bosni, gdje može pasti od 40 do 80 litara po kvadratnom metru.
For Friday a warning for heavy rain has also been issued in Herzegovina and southwestern Bosnia, where 40 to 80 litres per square metre may fall.
Civilna zaštita Kantona Sarajevo savjetuje građanima da s balkona sklone stvari koje vjetar može odnijeti.
Sarajevo Canton civil protection advises citizens to remove things from their balconies that the wind could carry away.
Automobile ne treba parkirati blizu velikih stabala, a izlete u prirodu treba odgoditi.
Cars should not be parked near large trees, and trips into nature should be postponed.
U subotu dolazi primjetno zahlađenje, a u višim dijelovima Bosne očekuje se snijeg.
On Saturday a noticeable cold spell arrives, and snow is expected in the higher parts of Bosnia.
Dnevna temperatura tada će biti od 2 do 8 stepeni, na jugu do 13.
The daytime temperature will then be from 2 to 8 degrees, up to 13 in the south.
